title: Deletion over aliasing: removing reader-local CredentialStore is correct
description: The reader had a 345-line CredentialStore in crates/reader/src/store/credentials.rs that was functionally identical to stoa_auth::CredentialStore. Options: (a) delete reader-local, use stoa_auth directly; (b) keep reader-local with a type alias to stoa_auth; (c) deprecated wrapper re-exporting the old type. Option (a) is correct. A type alias still requires maintaining an internal-but-parallel module. A deprecated wrapper leaves dead code in the tree, violating the project no-dead-code rule. Hard deletion forces all callers to import from stoa_auth, making the single-source-of-truth property enforced by the compiler. Critically, the security-sensitive timing-safe dummy-hash verification logic now lives in exactly one auditable location.
